title: Plates runs on its own practice
outcome: Every rule plates will ship is already holding on plates: phases own status, the roadmap is checked, lessons are shapes, and the conductor can walk the plan.

title: Start a project in one command
outcome: From an empty directory, plates init produces a repo whose check passes, whose roadmap renders, and that an agent can conduct the same day.

title: The fleet stays current
outcome: Existing projects come under plates without losing what is theirs, and a practice change reaches every one of them as a reviewed pull request.

title: Lessons come home
outcome: A lesson learned in any project, or a practice improved upstream, reaches plates, is decided by a person, and ships to the rest of the fleet.

title: The night shift keeps it working
outcome: Without anyone remembering, each project is measured nightly, dependencies move in reviewed lanes, and anything red reaches a person.

title: Plates knows whether it helps
outcome: Plates can show, with numbers across the fleet, whether projects it manages ship more and break less, and what conducting costs.

title: A change reaches production once, checked
outcome: Each change is verified in parallel and published one at a time; production moves only to a tested commit and is checked by the commit it serves; no change runs the expensive path twice.

title: Operate every Plates project from a private web workspace
outcome: From mobile and desktop, an authenticated owner operates every authorized Plates project: decisions, guided tests, visual changes, routine history and execution, fleet lessons and updates, scoped credentials and policy-bound model capacity, with source-backed evidence and private data.
